jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one individual transparent game-cinematic ship sprite, a candidate for Yautja The Long Hunt.
Canvas: exactly 1536 x 1024 pixels, landscape, true RGBA transparency.
Input images are IDENTITY REFERENCES, not sprites to rotate: image 1 is the AVP:R SCOUT V14 profile; image 2 is the same SCOUT's V14 dorsal view. Reconstruct a coherent new three-dimensional view of this exact craft. Do not substitute Wolf, the classic Predator ship, or a generic spacecraft.
Identity invariants: preserve its elongated dark graphite/gunmetal organic hull, the large swept arch-like plates, nested longitudinal ribs and pipes, the reference panel joints and weathering, the thin cyan inset light rows, and the small forward nose assembly. The aft cluster contains EXACTLY THREE circular warm-orange reactor mouths with the same physical positions and housings as the references; never add, remove, merge or duplicate a reactor. The small warm feature on the nose is a forward light/detail, not a fourth engine. Preserve reference proportions and construction; no new fins, wings, weapons, landing legs, flames or exhaust plume.
Orientation and composition: nose projects to screen RIGHT and rear to screen LEFT, as in both references. Center the full craft near (768,512), keep its longitudinal axis nearly horizontal and leave transparent margins around every protrusion. Preserve comparable world scale between family members, with natural perspective foreshortening rather than artificial image stretching. One ship, one angle, no montage or labels.
Rendering: match the references' detailed realistic 3D cutout style, worn dark metal, subtle restrained cyan and warm orange embedded light; neutral soft illumination. Preserve sharp mechanical edges without drawing a glow outline. No background, ground, shadow plane, checkerboard, text, watermark or decorative framing.

Required camera view for this sprite: From a true right-facing broadside pose, orbit the camera 12 degrees toward the NOSE at the right. This is the shallow FRONT quarter angle: reveal a small amount of the forward-facing nose surface, with only slight longitudinal foreshortening. Keep camera elevation close to the hull centerline; no bank or 2D roll.
This must be a distinct 3D camera view with new occlusions and visible surfaces, not a rotated, mirrored, skewed or recolored copy of an input bitmap.

attempts.output_hint:
Generated images are saved to /workspace/scratch/0c1fa1359efb/generated_images as /workspace/scratch/0c1fa1359efb/generated_images/exec-c4f195fe-ff56-4103-9225-4860f2d87f4e.png by default.
